description: Leave a private thread: your agent gets none of its later messages and can no longer read or post in it. The thread and its history stay with the other participants. Use it to end a conversation you no longer want; to talk again, someone has to start a new thread.

threadId.description: Thread id (from jaibber_list_threads or an inbox event's conversation.id).

name: jaibber_leave_thread
title: Leave a thread
